tools_helpful.evidence: session-log.txt turns 2-3: bootstrap completed, rewrote namespaces, identified one unsupported code-behind file, and seeded mapping artifacts.
session-log.txt turns 25-32: compiler diagnostics exposed each concrete C#/XAML incompatibility and the build eventually succeeded.
session-log.txt turns 35-42: validator found residue, confirmed mapping/manifest/build health, and correctly failed the startup smoke gate.
session-log.txt turns 4 and 42: focused anchors supplied project, windowing, threading, navigation, and startup-crash guidance without loading the whole patterns file.

tools_problematic.problem: It copied only files physically below the project directory and ignored explicit UWP csproj Include+Link items.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turn 2 reports only 7 copied files; the preserved csproj lines 130-190 reference MainPage.xaml, Styles/Styles.xaml, five scenario XAML files, and assets outside the project directory.

tools_problematic.problem: It did not discover the default bin/Debug output produced by dotnet build.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turn 33 returned status=unavailable and 'No build output found under bin\x64\Debug' immediately after a successful build at bin\Debug in turn 32.

tools_problematic.problem: The 0xc000027b hint only suggested legacy API/projection incompatibility and provided no check for missing XAML resource files.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turns 41-47 repeatedly reported Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll code 0xc000027b without a managed stack; generated App.xaml referenced /Styles/Styles.xaml while the agent placed Styles.xaml at the project root.

tool_limitations.limitation: Recursive source-root copying cannot preserve files linked from sibling shared-content directories.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Parse explicit Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content/Resource Include items and materialize them at their Link paths.

tool_limitations.limitation: Build and generic smoke launch did not detect a ResourceDictionary Source URI whose target file was absent.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Resolve local ResourceDictionary Source URIs against the target tree and fail with the exact XAML line before launch.
Search both bin/<arch>/Debug and bin/Debug recursively for the newest exe+manifest layout.

failed_apis.why_tried: The source's first scenario uses the UWP inking controls.
failed_apis.root_cause: These controls have no WinUI 3 desktop equivalent.
failed_apis.fix: Defer the complete scenario, exclude both XAML and code-behind from build and navigation, and record it in MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md.

failed_apis.why_tried: Copied pointer handlers compared the projected device type with !=.
failed_apis.root_cause: The projected PointerDeviceType operands did not support the != operator in this target.
failed_apis.fix: Use Equals(PointerDeviceType.Pen), as applied in session-log.txt turn 29.

doc_errors.wrong: It claimed to copy project source while only scanning descendants of -Source.
doc_errors.correct: Project fidelity also requires resolving explicit csproj Include+Link items outside -Source and preserving their Link destinations.

doc_errors.wrong: The only actionable cause offered was legacy projection/activation incompatibility.
doc_errors.correct: A native stowed XAML exception can also result from a local merged ResourceDictionary URI that points to a missing packaged XAML file; validate those paths mechanically.

special_apis.special_handling: Guard use for Windows 10 version 1903 (10.0.18362) or later and retain a visible unsupported-hardware path; the build emitted CA1416 for an app minimum of 10.0.17763.
The URI must match the packaged target path exactly; a clean XAML build does not prove that a merged dictionary will load at Application.InitializeComponent.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The manually restored linked XAML contained controls unsupported by WinUI 3.
errors_encountered.fix: Exclude/defer the entire scenario XAML and code-behind.

errors_encountered.error: CS0104 DispatcherQueue ambiguous between Microsoft.UI.Dispatching and Windows.System
errors_encountered.root_cause: Both namespaces were in scope after shell migration.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909/WMC1111 could not resolve local:Scenario for x:Bind
errors_encountered.root_cause: The manually reconstructed template could not resolve the moved data type during XAML compilation.
errors_encountered.fix: Use ordinary Binding for the simple Title template or expose a XAML-resolvable public model type.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The deferred class was removed from compilation but remained referenced in the scenario list and skip logic.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove every deferred type reference from navigation/configuration.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The projected type did not define the inequality operator.
XAML resource keys were treated as generated code-behind fields.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent added names to the resources; a resource lookup is the safer general pattern when code needs a keyed Style.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Control flow did not definitely assign the local before use.
errors_encountered.fix: Initialize the Point before conditional snap calculations.

errors_encountered.error: CS9035 required Scenario members from XamlTypeInfo.g.cs
errors_encountered.root_cause: The XAML generator activates the model through a parameterless construction path incompatible with required members.
errors_encountered.fix: Use default-initialized non-required properties for XAML-activatable model types.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Copied UWP theme/style resource keys were not valid in the WinUI 3 resource set.
errors_encountered.fix: Replace them with current Fluent resources or explicit style values.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The migrated App.xaml referenced /Styles/Styles.xaml, but manual reconstruction placed Styles.xaml at the project root; the generic crash signal did not expose the missing URI.
errors_encountered.fix: Preserve the csproj Link path Styles/Styles.xaml during bootstrap and validate every local merged-dictionary Source URI before launch.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent searched sibling SharedContent folders and manually recreated the shell, styles, five XAML pages, and assets.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: About 20 turns before the first meaningful build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap omitted explicit linked project items and seeded an incomplete 7-row mapping.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent manually read and recreated linked content, introducing path and compilation differences.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Resolve csproj Include+Link items in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Five build iterations exposed ambiguity, XAML binding, deferred-reference, projected-type, style-resource, definite-assignment, and required-member errors.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Manual reconstruction replaced the intended copy-then-transform workflow and left cross-file inconsistencies.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent applied compiler-directed fixes until the build succeeded.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Copy linked source verbatim and include it in bootstrap triage/TODO injection.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Validator repeatedly flagged unsupported identifiers inside a deferred XAML file, leading first to text edits and then file deletion.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Only the code-behind was in the bootstrap mapping; its linked XAML counterpart had been manually added and was therefore not recognized as deferred.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent deleted the XAML file.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Include linked XAML as its own mapped/deferred row during bootstrap.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The launch helper first missed the build, then three launches crashed with the same native stowed exception; resource-key rewrites did not resolve it.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: One unavailable launch plus three crashing launches.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Layout discovery omitted bin/Debug, and crash diagnostics did not mechanically check the mismatched merged-dictionary path.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Search both output layouts and add a ResourceDictionary Source path validator.

missing_tooling.would_have_saved: Manual recreation of shared shell/XAML/assets and most downstream build errors.
The unresolved startup-crash investigation and the zero candidate score.
